body.p: A gaming machine having an audio channel outputting
game sound and an audio channel intaking microphone sound and
outputing chat sound is coupled with a headset having earpieces and a microphone and a Bluetooth transceiver in the headset for
sending and receiving the microphone and chat sounds. A radio
receiver or wired connection in the headset receives the game
sounds. Circuitry in the headset is connected between the
transceiver and receiver for mixing the microphone, chat, and
game sounds and feeding them all to the earpieces.
